prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1276; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for side impact collision at signalized intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against the red signal and struck driver side door. Insured states no airbag deployment. Opened bodily injury and property damage exposures. Assigned field appraiser for vehicle inspection.

Entry 2: Claimant reports knee injury from impact, treating at urgent care. Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested all future communication be directed to the firm. Ceased direct contact with claimant per counsel instruction. Requested medical authorizations and prior records through counsel. Liability appears clear on preliminary review, pending police report.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Responding officer cited other driver for failure to obey traffic signal. Intersection camera footage requested from municipality. Vehicle appraisal completed; repair estimate exceeds total loss threshold for insured vehicle. Valuation request submitted to vendor.

Entry 4: Counsel submitted demand package including treatment records for knee injury, including imaging results and orthopedic consult notes. Records under review. Medical bills itemized and sent to bodily injury reserve review. Requested clarification from counsel on ongoing physical therapy schedule and expected treatment duration.

Entry 5: Reserves adjusted following review of medical documentation and repair valuation. Supervisor notified of represented claim and pending settlement evaluation. Diary set for follow-up with counsel upon receipt of remaining treatment records. File remains open pending final medical summary.
